# `state_program_approvals`

Federal Register rules and proposed rules in which a federal agency approves, authorizes or incorporates a state's own rules or program — mostly EPA state implementation plan (SIP) actions, plus RCRA and UST authorizations, SMCRA state programs and OSHA state plans. One row per (document, state); a document naming several states has a row for each. Selected from `federal_register` by an allow-list of state-program CFR parts, with the state read from the title. Covers only programs where a federal agency acts on state rules: it says nothing about state rules that never go to a federal agency. Sorted by `jurisdiction`, so `WHERE jurisdiction = ?` prunes row groups. Built by `build_state_program_approvals`.

- **Parquet file:** `state_program_approvals.parquet`
- **Queryable via MCP `query_sql`:** Yes

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `document_number` | `VARCHAR` | Federal Register document number (joins `federal_register.document_number`). |
| `publication_date` | `VARCHAR` | Date the document published in the Federal Register (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `document_type` | `VARCHAR` | `Rule` or `Proposed Rule`. |
| `title` | `VARCHAR` | FR document title. |
| `jurisdiction` | `VARCHAR` | USPS code of the state, DC or territory the action concerns (e.g. `VA`, `DC`, `PR`), read from the title. Titles naming only a county or air district with no state are not included. |
| `program` | `VARCHAR` | State program, from the CFR part: `sip` (40 CFR 52), `ocs_air` (40 CFR 55), `state_plan_111d` (40 CFR 62), `title_v` (40 CFR 70), `uic` (40 CFR 147), `mswlf` (40 CFR 239), `rcra` (40 CFR 271/272), `ust` (40 CFR 281/282), `osha_state_plan` (29 CFR 1952/1956), `smcra` (30 CFR 901-950). When a document cites several allow-listed parts, the first one FR lists. |
| `cfr_title` | `BIGINT` | CFR title of the allow-listed reference that selected the document. |
| `cfr_part` | `BIGINT` | CFR part of the allow-listed reference that selected the document. |
| `docket_ids_json` | `VARCHAR` | JSON array of docket IDs from the FR document (e.g. `EPA-R03-OAR-2025-0225`). Unnest it to join `dockets.docket_id` and reach the regulations.gov comments. |
| `state_citations_json` | `VARCHAR` | JSON array of state code sections the document cites, parsed from its full text, e.g. `["9VAC5-10-20"]` or `["COMAR 26.11.08.10"]`. Parsed for Virginia and Maryland only so far. NULL when the body was not parsed (other states; a fetch that failed; or an older document not yet reached, since each run parses at most 200 new bodies, newest first); `[]` when parsed and nothing was found. |
| `state_effective_date` | `VARCHAR` | State effective date of the approved rule (YYYY-MM-DD): the latest date in the document's state-effective-date table column, or, when there is no such table (e.g. proposed rules), the date in a "became effective on" sentence, for Clean Air Act programs only (`sip`, `state_plan_111d`, `title_v`, `ocs_air`). Dates after `publication_date` are dropped, since they come from text about the federal action. Parsed for Virginia and Maryland only; NULL otherwise or when not found. |
| `html_url` | `VARCHAR` | federalregister.gov page for the document. |
